_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic panel, razor-sharp confident brush-and-ink line, pristine architectural perspective, crisp silhouettes, clean expressive character geometry, generous negative space. a reference sheet of tiny hand-drawn margin marks in a row, each labeled: a two-stroke gull; a tiny crab from above; the gull with a small dog silhouette beside it; the gull at two-thirds size; a single clean horizontal stroke; a three-legged scruff of ink asleep; the gull and the scruff together; the word ROFLCOPTER lettered tiny; and a signature line reading A. Finch — Small Wood, OR. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, airbrush, neon, anime, watermark, extra fingers
